mentions.name: Ask HN projects-per-year analysis
mentions.description: This data analysis compiles the number of projects shared per year in the "Ask HN: What are you working on?" threads from 2008 through 2026, reporting yearly totals, monthly averages, and the top five keyword-classified topics per year.
